season.evidence: Logged hiking ascents on the trail cluster Aug-Sep (histogram peaks Jul-Sep); WebSearch of Travel Oregon / Oregon Project / SummitPost logs: summit hike done in summer after ski season, early-July snow still lingers up high, clearing later in July.

track.why: Only route we hold on the peak; logged as West Village Trail, Aug 9 2023, round trip from the West Village lot (start 128 m from our Trailhead pin), maintained trail, summits within 25 m of our pin and ~12 m of Peakbagger's coordinate.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Oct 20 2023 'North Slopes' round trip from West Village; in window but a different named line.
Aug 2022 Summit Trail but ends at Pine Marten Lodge (lift down), not a round trip.
Sep 2024 'Mount Bachelor Trail' but starts at Sunrise Lodge side, 1.7 km from our West Village pin.
Oct 2026 starts at Sunrise side, not our trailhead.
June snow climb on ski runs.

pins.name: Mount Bachelor
pins.evidence: Our pin is 122 m from Peakbagger's lidar-surveyed summit; 14 recorded highest points sit within 1-40 m of Peakbagger's coordinate.
pins.confirmedBy: Peakbagger peak 2423 coordinate (packet), tracks' highest points

facts.text: Start at the West Village base and head east along the bottom of the slope to a service road with a signed turnoff for the summit trail; above that the path is clear and keeps mostly off the ski runs.
Summit can be very windy and cold even on a mild August day

notes: Sunrise-side starts (~1.7 km NE) are common alternative; stored trailhead is West Village, which sources call the current start. Pin elevation 9047 ft vs surveyed 9071 ft.
